title: CSCI 518 — Collaborative Seminar in Computer Graphics
subject: Graphics and Visualization
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the standard stages of the OpenGL graphics pipeline and their sequential processing order.
Explain how geometric transformations and viewing models map 3D scene data to a 2D pixel grid.
Evaluate visual correctness by identifying how sampling decisions, shading models, and coordinate spaces impact rendering outcomes.
